pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Change matches the PR words: escapes \, %, _ in the LIKE search. It is a bug fix with one reasonable design, so no spec was needed.
No spec file in this change.
New tests cover %, _, mid-string % and backslash. They would fail on the old code, because ?q=%25 would match all items. I did not run them, since they need the Workers vitest pool.
README only says ?q= searches titles. That is still accurate.
Escaping order is correct, because a single regex pass handles backslash too. ESCAPE '\\' in the JS string yields ESCAPE '\' in SQL, which is valid. The query stays parameterised.
The input is still bound as a parameter. The change closes wildcard abuse and adds no injection surface.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters, and the body's claims match the diff.
